questions.answer: The index may help lookups by student_id; the chosen plan depends on the engine and data.
questions.explanation:
The index may help lookups by student_id; the chosen plan depends on the engine and data.
Why: An index is an additional data structure that can speed lookups on selected columns. PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE often create indexes; consider others for frequently filtered or joined columns. EXPLAIN and engine-specific analysis tools show a query plan. Indexes can speed reads but use storage and add work to INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE.
